_comment: Row 663. Seven seams of the rung decision plus the cross-implementation drift guard. M8 mutates runner_integrity, NOT this cut's own file: the inspector reimplements the runner's preference walk, so a row663 test must go red when the RUNNER's same-work subset is deleted, or the two copies are free to drift again -- which is the condition that created this row. Every anchor is zero-width (lookbehind + lookahead) so it names a DECISION, not a value.
subject: dry_run.inspect_candidates / _rung_decision -- the rung the runner would save

mutants.label: M1 drop resolution_tier from the accepted sort key (the 4K/8K tie falls to document order again)
M2 never apply quality_preference (always fall through to the top-ranked row)
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^    chosen = )(?=_prefer_rung\(ranked, qpref\) if qpref else None$)

mutants.label: M3 invert the min_resolution comparison so a below-floor rung is reported as selected
mutants.old_regex: (?m)(?<=^    if min_res > 0 and rung > 0 and )(?=rung < min_res:$)

mutants.label: M4 delete the UNKNOWN branch -- a missing site config silently claims a rung
M5 stop template_dry_run passing the site config through (seam 2)
M6 make tier_pixel_height answer 0 for every bucket
M7 delete the inspector's same-work subset (the escape the shape lens found)
M8 CROSS-IMPLEMENTATION DRIFT: delete the same-work subset from runner_integrity._apply_quality_preference
M9 claim 'selected' on a page whose work affinity is unknown
